about: The comparator's own test (tools/xdiff.py --mutations): each mutation breaks BN6's copy of the family after the install the way a transplant bug would (or, for the Souls, the rule UNITE runs by in BN6's engine: unitebreak, src/emu/soulunite.h's SOULUNITE_BREAK_*), and the spec named must FAIL on it. BN5 addresses are written to their copy (a virus family's by poke; a chip's moved code by poke5, as its BN5 addresses lie among BN6's own code), BN6's records' to where the game reads them; nothing of the ROMs here.

mutations.name: an immediate
mutations.what: the fire state's flag (lsls r0,r0,#0x16: 0x400000) shifted one less (0x200000): the wrong flag set as it fires

mutations.name: a state number not moved
mutations.what: the guard's CurAction left at BN5's 7 (BN6's frozen state) where the recipe makes it 9

mutations.name: an offset not moved
mutations.what: the reticle's read of a hit's flags left at BN5's +0x68 where BN6 keeps them at +0x70

mutations.name: a call aimed at a routine of nothing
mutations.what: the veneer to BN6's counter time aimed at the families' empty hook

mutations.name: a call aimed at the wrong twin
mutations.what: the veneer to BN6's routine that sets an object's flag (0x0801A152) aimed at its neighbour that clears it (0x0801A15C)

mutations.name: a table entry
mutations.what: AI 32's entry of the grown per-frame table (table 3) the empty hook: the reticle no longer let go as MegaMan leaves the row

mutations.name: a number in its data
mutations.what: the reticle's frames a panel for V1 11 where BN5 has 12

mutations.name: an effect id not moved
mutations.what: the muzzle blast spawned with BN5's effect id 0x57 (adds r4,#0x57) where the recipe gives BN6's 0x6C: in BN6's numbers another effect, which only the reference can say is the family's

mutations.name: an effect id not moved, beside a native
mutations.what: the same break in the smoke spec: the family's world is still the same at its first blast (the Mettaur's own differences compared on), so it must fail there

mutations.name: the strike's effect id
mutations.what: the reticle's strike spawning effect 0x0F where BN5's spawns 0x0E (movs r4,#0xe)

mutations.name: a region number
mutations.what: the reticle's collision data set up for region 6 where BN5's names region 4 (movs r1,#4 before the engine's setup): its +0x30 another word of the alliance table (BN5's 0x40000002 where 0x40000000), which only the tables' map reads as its own (legit.json, maps, alliance)

mutations.name: an immediate, Handi's
mutations.what: its wait's CurAction left at BN5's 7 (BN6's bubbled state) where the recipe makes it 9 (movs r0,#7 before its setAttack0)

mutations.name: a rebased call
mutations.what: the veneer of its panel's pick (BN5 0x08012DCC, BN6 0x08015FDC: a panel of its own side at random) rebased to the routine after it (0x08016004, a pick among the other side's panels, which draws as many numbers)

mutations.name: a shifted RNG call
mutations.what: its draws (GetPositiveSignedRNG, BN6 0x08001532) shifted onto the second word (GetPositiveSignedRNGSecondary, 0x08001562): the replay finds no draw of the reference's to give them, and they draw what they find

mutations.name: a wrong MOVED entry
mutations.what: the dispatch's MOVED entry for the reticle (the third kind's BN5 type 0x25, at XV_MOVED_TABLES + 0x400 + 4 x 0x25) the stray's routine, as if no family had moved it: the reticle let go as it first runs

mutations.name: a wrong TWIN
mutations.what: the dispatch's TWIN entry for BN5's type 0x25 (XV_TWIN_TABLES + 0x100 + 0x25) made BN6's own 0x25 where it is moved (0xFF): the reticle spawned as BN6's attack of that number

mutations.name: a spawn not retargeted
mutations.what: the veneer to the dispatch's spawner of the third kind (XV_SPAWN_3) aimed at BN6's own spawner (0x08003358), as before the dispatch: BN5's 0x25 spawned as BN6's 0x25

mutations.name: lava's flags
mutations.what: lava's word in BN6's grown flags table (xpanels.c, EMU_FREE + 0x4C0000 + 13 x 4) a plain panel's 0x10010 where BN5's lava gives 0x11010

mutations.name: lava underfoot not hooked
mutations.what: BN6's own push {r4,r6,lr} back over the hook at the actors' status step (BN6_OBJECT_STATUS), where BN5 steps an object on lava first: CanGard unhurt on lava, the lava not cooled

mutations.name: the sea underfoot not hooked
mutations.what: BN6's own cmp r0,#4 back over the hook in what a panel does to an actor (BN6_PANEL_STEP_POISON): the Fire CanGard on sea unhurt

mutations.name: lava's count not hooked
mutations.what: BN6's own cmp r0,#9 back over the hook in the per-panel update (BN6_PANEL_UPDATE_CONVEYOR): lava's timer written 0x708 each frame, never counted down, never running out

mutations.name: the cooling's panel
mutations.what: the stub's movs r2,#2 (the panel made plain as lava cools under MegaMan) made #3: a cracked panel

mutations.name: the spark's place unmoved
mutations.what: the stub's veneer to the routine that moves the spark's place by a random amount (BN6_PLACE_JITTER) aimed at the families' empty hook: no random number drawn as lava cools

mutations.name: Aqua cools no lava
mutations.what: the element hit's lava test in IWRAM (xpanels.c, BN6_PANEL_HIT_COOL + 0x26, written after the boot over the routine the game copied) made cmp r0,#15: an Aqua hit on lava leaves it, where BN5's cools it plain

mutations.name: MegaMan's buster flash
mutations.what: BN6's first flash of his buster spawned as its effect 7 where 6 (the arm flash's routine 0x080EC8B2: movs r4,#6 at 0x080EC8D6): MegaMan's own state, which a family spec reads as inconclusive (cangard_v1_keys stops there) and a MegaMan spec fails

mutations.name: a chip's damage
mutations.what: BN6's Cannon strikes for 41 where 40 (its chip record's +0x1A, 0x08021DA8 + 0x2C + 0x1A): CanGard's HP after the Cannon

mutations.name: a Soul's turns four
mutations.what: OK's commit of UNITE in BN6's engine gives a Soul 4 turns where BN5's gives 3 (0x08024FFA): KnightSoul's turns 4 at t1, its end a turn late

mutations.name: its used bit not set
mutations.what: the commit leaves the Souls' used word alone (BN5 ORs bit 11 in at 0x08025042): the same Soul could unite again in the battle; the used word 0 against BN5's 0x800

mutations.name: UNITE lit for a wrong kind
mutations.what: the check of the last pick lights a Soul for the kind after its own (BN5's table 0x08024BE4 read one off): KnightSoul (Break, 0xB) lit by a Cannon (no kind, 0xC), which BN5 leaves grey: BN6 unites

mutations.name: Beast Out lit while united
mutations.what: the emblem's lit test (0x0802A57A) not answered grey while a Soul is united: A on it takes Beast Out from the proxy, form 0x14 (TenguBeast) where the spec holds form 8

mutations.name: a Soul kept past a Cross
mutations.what: leaving the proxy for a Cross keeps the Soul in the Souls' block (the proxy's removal entry not clearing it): KnightSoul still named in HeatCross where the spec holds none

mutations.name: a moved chip's family in its record
mutations.what: CrakOut's record (the registry's 298 at CHIPS_RECORDS) naming family 0x6C, whose grown entry is the stub, where the install gives it 0x6B: MegaMan's attack ends at once

mutations.name: a moved family's entry
mutations.what: the grown attack families' entry 0x6B (FREE_ATTACK_FAMILIES + 0x16C) left at the stub (XATTACK_STUB) where the install points it at CrakOut's moved code

mutations.name: a number in a moved family's code
mutations.what: CrakOut's wait (movs r0,#0xF at BN5's 0x080EC8BA, written at its copy) one frame shorter: the crack a frame early

mutations.name: a moved object's type
mutations.what: HotBody's aura spawned as BN5's fourth kind's 0x56 (movs r0,#0x57 at BN5's 0x080E6CF8, written at its copy), a type the dispatch was given none of

mutations.name: a moved family's sound
mutations.what: HotBody's sound 0xF7 (movs r0,#0xF7 at BN5's 0x080DA4B6, written at its copy) played as 0xF6

mutations.name: a moved chip's family, HotBody's
mutations.what: HotBody1's record (462) naming family 0xA7 (the stub) where the install gives it 0xA8

mutations.name: a moved support routine's entry
mutations.what: the grown support routines' entry 0x3D (XC_SUPPORT + 0xF4) left at their stub (XC_STUBS) where the install points it at Jealousy's moved routine

mutations.name: a moved support routine's object type
mutations.what: Jealousy's object spawned as BN5's fourth kind's 0x35 (movs r0,#0x36 at BN5's 0x080E462C, written at its copy) where BN6's twin 0x36 runs

mutations.name: a moved chip's subfamily in its record
mutations.what: NrthWind's record (457) naming support entry 0x3E (the stub) where the install gives it 0x3F

mutations.name: a moved support routine's object type, NrthWind's
mutations.what: NrthWind's wind spawned as BN5's fourth kind's 0x38 (movs r0,#0x39 at BN5's 0x080E4940, written at its copy) where BN5's own 0x39 runs, moved
